title: TOC Table Border Inset Fix
summary: Fixed inward-offset vertical borders and header-to-first-row gap on register longtables by moving chrome padding inside the vertical rules (|@{\hspace{padding}} ... @{\hspace{padding}}|) instead of outside them, matching tcolorbox Window layout. Updated continuation chrome multicolumn to the same frame order and corrected its inner hbox width to linewidth minus rule widths.
